admission.method: hourly log-return lag vs Binance BTCUSDT H1 (UTC-native). Peak lag must be 0. Floor 0.95 on a long UTC-native overlap; fail-closed if the tape is a shifted UTC label.
admission.verdict: clock admitted — unique lag-0 peak; long H1 book clears 0.95; M5 vs spot 0.917 is CFD/spot residual not a 1h shift; 10800 path rejected

holdout.rule: et_date < 2026-03-01 develop / selection; et_date >= 2026-03-01 holdout evaluation only; NEVER used for selection

costs.slippage_note: STATED ASSUMPTION after measuring median M5 spread 1600 pts ($16). 10% of median = 160 pts ($1.60/side). Not index 10 pt. Not ny-1330 H1 800.
costs.max_spread_note: rounded ~p95 of FP M5 spread (p50=1600, p95=1925, p99=3030). Skip fills above cap.
costs.spread_imputation: 7 zero-spread bars: forward-fill previous bar spread within the same ET day, else global median 1600
costs.cost_formula: round trip = (spread_pts + 2 * slippage_points) * point_size * contract_size * lots + 2 * commission_per_lot * lots, charged once at fill
